description: Source file implementing RPC types and utilities for torch distributed RPC, including thread-local flags, ID classes, and serialization helpers.

classes.name: JitRRefPickleGuard
classes.description: Guard class managing the thread-local flag for JIT RRef pickling scope.

classes.name: GloballyUniqueId
classes.description: Class representing a globally unique identifier with creation info and local ID.

classes.name: SerializedPyObj
classes.description: Class for serializing and deserializing Python objects with tensors and payload.

methods.name: getAllowJitRRefPickle
methods.description: Returns whether JIT RRef pickling is allowed in the current scope.

methods.name: enableJitRRefPickle
methods.description: Enables JIT RRef pickling in the current thread scope.

methods.name: disableJitRRefPickle
methods.description: Disables JIT RRef pickling in the current thread scope.

methods.name: SerializedPyObj::toIValues
methods.description: Serializes the object to a vector of IValues.

methods.name: SerializedPyObj::fromIValues
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a vector of IValues.
